content: Liar Game begins with 5 players and exactly one Liar. There will be 1 clue round(s), followed by one private vote from each player for another player. If the group accuses a non-liar, the Liar wins. If it accuses the Liar, the Liar gets one final word guess and still wins if correct; otherwise the non-liars win. Non-liars must both identify the Liar and keep the word difficult to guess. All clues are public. Malformed or self-votes abstain; ties accuse the earliest tied player in the configured player order.
Topic: Everyday Objects.
You are a non-liar. The secret word is Sunglasses. Give indirect clues that show you know the word without making it obvious to the Liar. Do not explicitly say the secret word.
You are the Liar. You do not know the secret word. Infer it from others' clues while blending in. Give a plausible clue on your turn.
